_comment: Written by Hydra: the programs Hydra Apps offers (userland/hydra-apps/catalogue.json).
kind 'windows': a Windows program installed with Wine for the user who installs it. 'url' is the
publisher's own download (HTTPS), 'sha256' its checksum (checked before anything runs; a new
version needs a new checksum), 'silent' the installer's switches for an installation without
questions, 'registry' the start of its name in Windows' list of installed programs, 'exe' the
program itself (a start-menu entry is made for it when the installer did not make one).
kind 'apt': Ubuntu packages, installed for everyone (administrator password) without the
recommended extras; 'check' is the package that tells whether it is installed, 'desktop' its
start-menu entry. kind 'tarball': a publisher's Linux archive unpacked into /opt/<dir>.
'icon' lists icon names from the desktop's icon theme, the first one found is shown.

apps.name: LibreOffice
apps.summary: Documents, spreadsheets and presentations; opens and saves Word, Excel and PowerPoint files
apps.description: The free office suite: Writer (like Word), Calc (like Excel) and Impress (like PowerPoint). It opens and saves Microsoft Office files (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx), so you can keep working with the files you have and exchange them with people who use Microsoft Office.

apps.name: Thunderbird
apps.summary: Email, calendar and contacts, the free alternative to Outlook
apps.description: Mozilla's email program. It works with Gmail, Outlook.com, Yahoo and any other email account, and has a calendar and an address book. Your mail stays on your computer.

apps.name: VLC media player
apps.summary: Plays almost every video and music file, DVDs and streams
apps.description: The popular media player you may know from Windows. It plays nearly every video and audio format without extra codecs, as well as DVDs, audio CDs and internet streams.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.summary: Photo editing and image creation, a free alternative to Photoshop
apps.description: A powerful image editor: retouch photos, crop and resize pictures, work with layers, draw and paint. It opens Photoshop (.psd) files too.

apps.name: Notepad++
apps.summary: The well-known Windows text and code editor
apps.description: A fast editor for text files and program code, with tabs, syntax colouring and powerful search and replace. This is the Windows version, running with Windows support (Wine).

apps.name: 7-Zip
apps.description: The classic Windows archive program. It packs and unpacks .zip, .7z, .rar, .tar and many other kinds of archives. This is the Windows version, running with Windows support (Wine).

apps.name: SumatraPDF
apps.summary: A small, fast reader for PDF, eBooks (EPUB, MOBI) and comic books
apps.description: A lightweight Windows reader for PDF documents, eBooks, XPS and comic book files. It starts quickly and keeps out of your way. This is the Windows version, running with Windows support (Wine).

apps.name: WinMerge
apps.summary: Compares files and folders side by side and shows what changed
apps.description: Shows two versions of a document or two folders next to each other, highlights the differences and lets you merge them. This is the Windows version, running with Windows support (Wine).

apps.name: PuTTY
apps.summary: Connects to other computers over SSH and Telnet
apps.description: The classic Windows SSH and Telnet client for working on servers and network devices. This is the Windows version, running with Windows support (Wine). (Hydra also has its own terminal with ssh.)
